items.headline: COP31 Climate Summit Extended in Turkey Over Fossil Fuel Impasse
items.summary: The COP31 UN climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, went into overtime after delegates failed to reach an agreement before the scheduled deadline. Negotiators are holding extended talks to bridge deep divisions between nations pushing to phase out fossil fuels and oil-producing states resisting those terms.

items.headline: Independent Groups Verify Claim That AI Helped Prove the Riemann Hypothesis
items.summary: On November 21, two independent organizations verified a claim by an Anthropic mathematician that the AI model Claude assisted him in proving the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis. The verification represents a landmark milestone in using artificial intelligence to solve complex, long-unsolved scientific problems.

items.headline: Tyler Herro Scores Career-High 50 Points in Heartbreaking Bucks Loss to 76ers
items.summary: Milwaukee Bucks guard Tyler Herro scored a career-high 50 points on Saturday, but his potential game-tying three-pointer at the final horn was ruled to have been released just after the buzzer. The Philadelphia 76ers held on for a 132-129 victory, overshadowing Herro's historic night as he became the first NBA player to record 50 points, 11 rebounds, seven three-pointers, and 65% shooting in a single game.

items.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI Sets Entertainment Record With $3.79 Billion First-Day Sales
items.summary: Rockstar Games announced that Grand Theft Auto VI generated $3.79 billion in worldwide retail sales on its first day, making it the largest launch for any entertainment product in history. The video game sold over 32 million copies prior to release and surpassed the total lifetime box office earnings of major Hollywood blockbusters in just 24 hours.
